observations.why: The operational 'We're switching' performs a settled change rather than merely proposing one.
The benefits are stated plainly but do not themselves settle an action, so this is a claim rather than a decision.
The migration is presented as a firm position, but the segment does not independently perform or record ratification; split footing also makes the principal's conviction reported.
This is an unhedged performance assertion, but it does not settle an action or establish bedrock conviction; split footing makes the observation reported.
The timeline is stated plainly, but no explicit ratification or operational commitment makes it decision-grade; the principal is the session and the rendering is split-footing.
